diagnosis: The bulk deletion route deletes articles matching article_ids as long as their status is 'draft'. It fails to restrict the queryset by author or workspace (author=request.auth), permitting any authenticated author to delete draft campaigns and content created by other editorial teams.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/articles/bulk HTTP/1.1
Host: cms.mediahub.com
Authorization: Bearer <author_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"article_ids": [102, 103, 104, 105]}
corrected_code:
from ninja import Router, Schema
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from .models import MarketingArticle

class BulkDeleteSchema(Schema):
    article_ids: list[int]

router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@router.delete("/articles/bulk", response={204: None})
def delete_draft_articles(request, data: BulkDeleteSchema):
    MarketingArticle.objects.filter(
        id__in=data.article_ids,
        status="draft",
        author=request.auth
    ).delete()
    return 204, None
